decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress probe is publicly celebrated and central to the firm's geothermal direction, so heavy visible commitment makes dropping it very unlikely.
The single-U probe is a core part of the established geothermal probe range with integrated production investment, and there is no evidence of failure.
This multi-model surface technology line supports the firm's geothermal probes and represents a sizable technological investment the firm would want to justify.
Fire-protection profile systems require costly certifications and are close to the core steel profile business, so writing them off would waste substantial sunk investment.
The slim steel profile system is close to the established offer and was presented on its own page, so the firm is likely to persist with it given its invested tooling and system development.
The decorative surface system is a less central add-on with lower investment, making it somewhat more expendable, but nothing indicates failure that temporary causes could not explain.
